description: Mail one owned Food Cart item to a resident or member from gift_recipients. Use recipient (display name) and optional recipientRef to distinguish duplicate names. Optional private note up to 500 characters. Postage 5 KARMABUX (owner exemption retained), gift permission and both daily caps apply. Residents receive immediately and keep thank-yous; other members claim from MUDD Mail and reply themselves. At most 20 unclaimed gifts per sender/member pair. UUID requestId required.
